verdict.rationale: Square AI (Beta) is a built-in seller assistant that answers natural-language questions over the seller's own sales and inventory data, pulls in web context, and is pitched as surfacing "game-changing insights". Vendor-hosted testimonials describe best-seller analysis and charting, and separate ML-driven fraud-pattern insights add further in-product AI analysis. Missing for 10: GA status (it is still Beta), explicit evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations beyond answering questions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
